thread:
emma: Heads up — prepping the 2026-03-23 deploy for model-routing v3. Planning a quiet-window toggle for the new ff 'llmroute_v3_enable' during the 02:00–04:00 UTC change window. Deploybot will perform a staged ramp: 0% -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 30m intervals.

kai: Sounds good. Can we pin traffic to v2 for the first 2m after the change to avoid early drift?

emma: yes — pin 100% to v2 for 2m, then unblock to the ramp. Deploybot command below.

emma: ```/deploybot start deploy --app inference --version v3.0-llmroute --ff llmroute_v3_enable --ramp 0,1,10,50 --ramp-interval 1800 --pin-after-start 120 --notify-channel eng-releases```

deploybot: Ack: I queued the deploy and will emit rollout events to this thread. Will pin traffic for 120s, then follow the ramp. Health gates: 5xx rate, p50 latency, embedding-error-rate.

oliver: What are the rollback triggers? define thresholds pls.

emma: Rollback triggers: >1% increase in 5xx over baseline for 10m OR p50 latency regress >20% sustained for 5m OR embedding-error-rate >0.5% for any 5m window. If triggered, auto-drain and pin back to v2, then notify oncall.

kai: Add a soft-failover: if autoscaling lag spikes > 60s during ramp step, pause and hold at previous step, alert infra team.

emma: good call — added. Also writing a short release notes blurb now.

emma: "Release notes (internal): Deploy v3.0 of model-routing stack — introduces route consolidation and improved KV cache locality. Feature flag llmroute_v3_enable controls gradual rollout. Expected perf: p50 down ~8–12% in steady state. Rollback policy attached in internal runbook'"

jamal: Can we also document which customers are in the initial 1% cohort? Need privacy-safe list for CS.

emma: I'll export the cohort filter and drop to ops-sec Slack. cc @sasha for CS comms.

sasha: Got it. I'll draft a short CS note saying "We are rolling experimental routing to a small cohort. No action needed from customers; we'll notify if any impact is detected."

oliver: Quick ask: ensure the deploy includes the new telemetry keys so Optimize can surface batch and cache hit deltas.

emma: yes telemetry key added: route_v3.cache_hits, route_v3.batch_size. deploybot will emit metrics under /infra/llmroute/v3.

deploybot: Event: deploy started (8150000020). Pin active for 120s.

oliver: watching dashboards.

deploybot: Event: ramp to 1% (8150000140). Health check running.

kai: Observability note — set alert mute to 5m to avoid noisy alerts during each ramp step, but keep severity-high alerts unmuted.

emma: Done. Mute applied to non-sev alerts.

deploybot: Event: ramp to 10% (8150000440). Gate check: p50 within baseline, 5xx stable.

jamal: CS draft ready, sending to sasha for review.

deploybot: Event: ramp to 50% (8150000740). All gates pass. Finalize release notes and snapshot runbook.

emma: Thanks team. Leaving deploy open for manual rollforward. If any of the rollback triggers fire, I will call rollback and pin to v2. Otherwise we'll schedule a gradual ramp to 100% tomorrow morning UTC. :thumbsup:

oliver: ACK. I'll still keep a watch for embedding tail errors.

sasha: CS note sent to stakeholders.

deploybot: Event: deploy complete (8150000275) — rollout at 50% (manual rollforward pending). Logs: https://internal.redwood/infralog/8150000000

emma: closing thread — will open a wrap-up with perf deltas after 6 hours."
